description: List daily activity: activity score (0-100) and contributors, steps, active, total and target calories, walking-equivalent distance in km, minutes of high/medium/low activity, sedentary, resting and non-wear hours, and inactivity alerts. Use it for movement, step and calorie questions over a range; individual workouts are in list_workouts. An Oura activity day runs 4 a.m. to 4 a.m., so today's row is partial. Range: the last 7 days by default; set start and end (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) or days (up to 400, ignored when start is set). Returns { records, next_token }, oldest first. Days without data are absent, and today's data appears only after the ring syncs. If next_token is not null, call again with it for the rest. raw: true returns Oura's original objects.

days.description: Shortcut for start: the last N days up to end. Ignored when start is set.

end.description: Last day to include (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

next_token.description: Pass the next_token from a previous call to get the following records.

raw.description: Return Oura's raw API objects instead of compact summaries with friendly units.

name: list_daily_activity
title: List daily activity
